All 9 tests now pass under `node --test`. I changed one line in each source file and left the tests alone.

1. **`src/bill.js`, off-by-one in `splitBill`:** the leftover cents were handed out with `i <= leftover`, so one payer too many got an extra cent. The total was wrong, and so were the even split and the leftover-cents case. It is now `i < leftover`.
2. **`src/duration.js`, unvalidated input in `parseDuration`:** it only checked that at least one `\d+[hms]` match existed. Input like `"10m and change"` was accepted and the junk was ignored. It now requires the whole string to match `^(?:\d+[hms])+$`, otherwise it throws `SyntaxError`.
